Ava (AE): quick heads-up — Acadia Health (pilot) asked for a 6mo committed POC and is requesting a 30% off standard hosted rates + a short window to try Dedicated failover during spikes. They want pricing to be locked for the POC. :eyes:
Lukas (Sales Eng): technical note — for the POC they'll need predictable throughput for peak batch jobs. Dedicated pool makes sense for reliability; fallback to hosted is fine for overflow.
Ava (AE): high-level numbers from the customer: ~1.2B tokens/month peak estimate; they want a simple committed discount to present to procurement.
Priya (Deal Desk): can you drop the raw $ numbers? I need ARR/commit to map to discount bands. Also: are they referenceable? exec sponsor?
Ava (AE): yes — they can be referenceable, exec sponsor is VP Product. Rough list calc:
```
List monthly spend at hosted rates: $45,000
Requested: 30% off -> $31,500/month
6mo commit total: $189,000 (pre-tax)
```
Lukas (Sales Eng): note — if we offer Dedicated pricing for commit, unit economics shift (lower per-token cost). My suggested split: 20% off hosted + complimentary Dedicated burst for first 2 weeks, OR 30% off if they commit to a reserved Dedicated slot for the 6mo.
Priya (Deal Desk): standard book: discounts >25% require CRO signoff; >30% needs RevOps + finance review. Need: 1) contract length, 2) committed $ / M, 3) referenceability clause, 4) PO or payment terms.
Ava (AE): contract = 6 months; committed = $31.5k/mo (if we accept 30%); referenceable = yes; payment = monthly invoiced.
Zoe (Legal): also flag: SSO + data handling addendum needed for Dedicated access. If they want Dedicated in their VPC/on-prem, we'll need an SOW and security scoping.
Ethan (RevOps): tagging in: @Priya @Ava — quick answer on discount cap: we can provisionally approve up to 30% on a case-by-case with CRO acknowledgement and with a registered reference and signed PO. Finance needs to confirm cash flow schedule.
Priya (Deal Desk): request to CRO sent via DM. For the thread: please add a short Customer Qualification note (why special):
- Strategic healthcare logo (good reference in-healthcare)
- High potential for long-term Dedicated conversion
- Fast timeline (POC in 2 weeks)
Ava (AE): added timeline: kickoff in 10 business days.
Lukas (Sales Eng): one more technical constraint — KV cache warm-up could spike cost first 48-72 hrs; recommend we include a 'warm-up credit' (one-time) or allow overage forgiveness for week 1.
Priya (Deal Desk): warm-up credit is fine; include in SOW as a one-time $5k credit if they convert to Dedicated reserved capacity.
DeployBot: new quote 1852506805 generated by quote-service for Acadia Health (link: https://redwood.app/quotes/1852506805)
Ethan (RevOps): CRO replied in DM: fine to approve up to 30% contingent on exec sponsor + signed PO + reference clause. I'll mark this provisional and route to finance for PO terms. :thumbsup:
Priya (Deal Desk): OK — I'll draft the exception memo and SOW language (warm-up credit + Dedicated fallback) and circulate for signatures.
Ava (AE): thanks team — I'll prep customer-facing doc and ask them to sign LOI this week. :rocket:
